prompt: We had a wrong charge reach a customer last week even though the dashboard says the test suite covers over 90% of the code. I do not trust the tests under test/ for the cart and checkout pricing any more. Please make them trustworthy for the pricing side of this repo: carts, discounts and coupons, tax, shipping and the order total. Put your new cases in test/qa-edge-cases.test.js (you may also fix or extend the existing test files), keep the suite runnable with `node --test`, and use the existing Node.js 24 CommonJS setup. Do not change anything under src/, the package files, data, docs or CI, and add no dependencies or generated files.

rubric.criterion: Test names explain the customer-facing rule each case protects (code cannot check this because executable checks can count cases but cannot judge whether their descriptions are clear).
